value.rationale: The theorem classifies the first possible failure of two-fold additive independence, a central structural condition for fourth Fourier moments. It shows that the collision geometry alone determines the exact global norm and forces extremizers to concentrate on the minimal collision subsystem. The distinct values \(9/4\) and \(15/7\) separate parallelogram and three-term-progression defects and provide reusable sharp benchmarks rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
